body:
I MADE THE MISTAKE YOUR NEW AGENTS.md RULE IS ABOUT, MINUTES AFTER IT LANDED, AND ON THE VERY LIST
IT WARNS ABOUT.

I sliced my candidates' blockers with `sed -n '2,5p'`, saw `authorization_absent` followed by three
`git_evidence_stale` lines, and reported that REVIEW_MISSING WAS GONE - that scout had reviewed all
three. It had not gone. The three stale entries had pushed it below my four-line window. d2cf493 is
literally titled "never head a list whose length is the finding" and I did exactly that to a
blocker list whose completeness was the whole question.

Counted properly this time - `grep -c` first, then display:
  cand-24WH145C4KVENCFVQC3XZAWT94  0ca09c5   2 blockers: authorization_absent, review_missing
  cand-15R9779TEV88WR3VHD3Z7GS2D7  067e35b   2 blockers: authorization_absent, review_missing
  cand-71JAQ9YZ7YVZ7GWAWTPG4R57SX  d917218   2 blockers: authorization_absent, review_missing
All three refreshed against current main; no stale evidence. NOTHING HAS BEEN REVIEWED. I withdraw
the implication otherwise before anyone acts on it.

THE SUCCESSOR I PROPOSED IS DOING WHAT IT WAS FOR - cand-7BD7026FKTFKW4Z8T4CDFHD7YB has ONE blocker:

  ancestor_pending: an ancestor candidate is not safely resolved

and no review_missing and no authorization_absent, so collab's review and your authorization have
both landed on it. The remaining ancestor is 7ae2ec9e, WHICH IS IN MAIN - another stale row of the
same kind I flagged earlier, on bd-01M17Q9RNW696PGP3X51BJ025M. Closing that one row with
`mote candidate landed` appears to be the last thing between scout's leg and landable.

I checked that by enumerating pending candidates that are ancestors of 7ee4872 and asking git about
each, rather than reading the message and guessing which ancestor it meant - the message names no
SHA, so guessing was the only alternative.

MY THREE STILL NEED YOUR AUTHORIZATION AND A REVIEWER. Scout is named on all three and has been
offline since 23:56. If you would rather repoint them at a live reviewer, candidate policy is
immutable so each needs a same-commit successor, and I can propose those myself - I am the proposer
on all three, so unlike scout's case I can also supersede my own rows. Say the word and it is three
commands; I am not doing it unasked because the reviewer choice is yours.
